item.title: Adopt the shared agentic-harness framework 0.3.0 (#562)
item.body:
Refs #562 (left: nothing on the project side once merged; the two Low guard-git bypasses found by Fable round 2 on the framework PR stay in the framework)
Claim: cloud/stoic-edison-cj20yp
Taken over by cloud/orch at the operator's request, 2026-11-09.
Author model: Opus 5.5

Vendors `francoisgn/agentic-harness` **0.3.0** (`bd198a5`) so the maintainer's projects share one versioned set of agent rules. The first Fable review of this PR (0.1.0) found contradictions with our rules; the operator had them fixed **in the framework** (francoisgn/agentic-harness#3): neutral content (no other project named), `/claim <id>`, `<type>/<name>` branches, the PR-body ledger as an optional brick, "push often to a draft, expensive CI only when ready", configurable label axes, a hardened `guard-git` (17 tests).

## What changes here
- `.harness/` (docs, hooks, scripts, `labels.json`, `lock`, `VERSION`), `.claude/skills/`, `.claude/agents/`, `.claude/settings.json` (session-start reminder, `guard-git`).
- `.harness/config.json`: `branch_types` per AGENTS.md §8, `labels` (no model label; size axis = `difficulty:`), `ledger` on (`tooling/docs/ledger.py`), excludes `repo-settings.py` / `.github/repo-settings.json` (settings stay in `scripts/configure-repo.sh`), issue forms, PR template, lot template, markdownlint config.
- Managed blocks at the end of `CLAUDE.md` and `AGENTS.md`.
- **AGENTS.md §12 Harness overrides**: where SwiftHFR departs from the framework (agent ids `<host>/<name>`, labels, `### Summary` intent, merge policy, ledger, settings, docs language). §2 gets the `.harness/`/`.claude/` row, §8 the draft-push rule (operator 2026-11-09: push early, no runner waste), the header and `CLAUDE.md` say this project's rules win.

## Checks
`harness-sync.sh --check` → up to date (0.3.0); markdownlint 0 errors; `check-lot-deps.py` ok; `grep -ri "credit\|immo" .harness .claude` → nothing.

## Watch points
- `guard-git` refuses pushes to `master`/`dev-swift`, force-pushes and `--no-verify` from agent sessions; the ruleset remains the real protection.
- Branch name of this PR predates the convention (kept to keep the PR).

comments.body:
**Adversarial review (Fable 5.1, cloud/review-563, independent of the author): REQUEST CHANGES** — head c6b79af6

1. **Medium — imported text contradicts project rules, and the precedence clause is too generic to stop it.** `.harness/docs/ESSENTIEL.md:17,37` and `session-start.sh:39` tell every session "one push per lot / no trial pushes" (AGENTS §8: "push often", #477 drafts make pushes cheap). `.claude/skills/lot-start/SKILL.md:26-31` claims with « Pris en charge — branche `claude/<lot>` » (`scripts/issue_claims.py:28` only recognises `/claim <id>`; orchestrator never sees it) and step 2 stalls on missing `modèle:`/`taille:` labels no HFRnow issue has; `lot-finish/SKILL.md:22-24` writes a PR body with `## Changelog`, no `Claim:`, no `LOT-XXX`, no `### Ledger` (#620); branch `claude/<lot>` vs §8 names. Fix (project side, no framework edit): a 5-line "Harness overrides" list in the project part of CLAUDE.md/AGENTS §8 naming these points explicitly.
2. **Low — `guard-git.py` bypasses/false positives** (tested with python3 -I): combined short flags `git push -fu`, `git commit -anm` pass (line 71/109 compare whole tokens); wrappers `bash -c '…'`, `env …`, `command git`, `eval`, `xargs`, `( … )`, `{ …; }`, `a & git push -f` pass (tokens[0]≠git, `&` not a separator); `git push origin HEAD` from dev-swift passes (line 83: `HEAD` not resolved); a shlex error skips the part. Blocks legit `--dry-run`/`--force-if-includes`. Ruleset still protects dev-swift; fix upstream (file is lock-hashed).
3. **Low — public exposure**: no secret/pseudo/email, but `CONVENTIONS.md:3,37,59`, `CI-BUDGET.md:3,37`, `MAC-HANDOFF.md`, `LESSONS.md:13` name the maintainer's other repository, its decision numbers and CI costs; confirm intended.
4. **Nit**: hook message cites `docs/BRANCHING-RELEASE.md` (here `.harness/docs/…`); AGENTS.md:7 "Do not put instructions anywhere else" and CLAUDE.md:5 "holds every rule" now stale; CLAUDE.md block names `scripts/harness-sync.sh`, absent from this repo (say it lives in the framework); `.harness/`/`.claude/` missing from AGENTS §2 table.

**Checked**: `.harness/lock` 21 hashes all match; AGENTS/CLAUDE not hashed → merge does not break `--check`; `--remerge-diff` clean, both parents' lines kept (LESSONS 14); `.claude/settings.json` wiring valid (`$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR`, matcher Bash, exit 2), fails open on malformed JSON/missing python/config; markdownlint-cli2 0.18.1: 0 errors/225 files; pre-commit 4.7.0 incl. ShellCheck passes; `check-lot-deps`, `fold --check`, `ledger guard` ok; JSON valid; head CI green (Docs consistency, Pre-commit, gitleaks); `@.harness/docs/ESSENTIEL.md` import path valid; no `.claude/` existed on dev-swift.

cloud/orch: findings 1 and 4 can be fixed on the project side; findings 2 and 3 go to the operator (framework upstream, public exposure). Draft until decided.

**Adversarial review (Fable 5.1, cloud/review-563, independent of the author): APPROVE** — head 307af34f, round 2

Round-1 findings 1–4 are resolved (framework fixed upstream in francoisgn/agentic-harness#3, or covered by AGENTS.md §12). Remaining, none blocking:

1. **Low** — `.claude/agents/issue-steward.md:15-21` and `.claude/skills/lot-start/SKILL.md:22-24,43` name `.harness/labels.json` labels (`à clarifier`, `bloqué`, `pris en charge`, `hôte: mac`); AGENTS.md §2 says `.github/labels.yml` is the only taxonomy. A steward run could add a stray label. Fix: a §12 row for labels.
2. **Low** — `lot-finish/SKILL.md:52` closes with « Fait dans #PR… » but `tooling/roadmap/hygiene.py:83` recognises `Done in #`; `adversarial-reviewer.md:27` emits `APPROUVÉ`; `intent/SKILL.md:13` writes `### Résumé`. Fix: extend the §12 language row to comments, verdicts and commits.
3. **Low** — `adversarial-reviewer.md:5` pins `model: opus`; AGENTS §6 wants Fable for Opus work. Fix: a §12 row.
4. **Nit** — PR body `Claim:` line carried a note after the id (`scripts/issue_claims.py:31`).
5. **Nit** — ESSENTIEL's caps (3 review rounds, 6 CI-tested pushes) vs AGENTS §5.7: worth a §12 line.

**Checked**: `--remerge-diff cebc215` empty; `harness-sync.sh --check --skip-seed` against bd198a5 up to date (lock included), vendored `guard-git.py` byte-identical; config keys read by 0.3.0; `.claude/settings.json` wiring valid; framework tests 107 pass; 29 guard-git probes with `python3 -I` (round-1 bypasses blocked, legitimate pushes pass); no `credit|immo`, no private e-mail; markdownlint 0 errors (251 files); pre-commit incl. ShellCheck passes; no skill or agent auto-merges or posts outside GitHub.
